candidate.continuousIntegration: green on all four jobs on this exact commit

evidenceBasis: every passed item was verified from outside the session, against files on disk and the session's own recorded tool calls, not from the coordinator's account of its work

checks.note: args [<resolved>/dist/server.js, --cycle-managed=minimax-code-cycle-plugin], script first; A15-B03 did not recur
five agents created; five profiles byte-exact with allow-lists intact
action noop with profile.read on_disk and profile.source read-by-control-plane for every role
role-scoped spec responses in the session records; no reassembly attempted

provenLive.evidence: assess returned noop with profile.read on_disk and profile.source read-by-control-plane for all five roles; the absent-agent short-circuit did not fire
session records show role-scoped spec responses carrying one profile each; no 18 KB artifact, no reassembly
the request supplied both profile_root and project_root as the corrected procedure requires; step 2 completed without a stop

notProven.reason: the refusal to rewrite past a lost or widened allow-list was never triggered, because nothing went wrong

findings.requirement: a setup run can reach ready
findings.observed: step 4 requires native task session event/tool records for every managed agent; the host exposes no such surface — task returns a child's work, not its tool roster, and session message returns conversation content, not event/tool records
findings.consequence: ready is unreachable on MiniMax Desktop 3.0.68.134, not merely unproven, and all eleven behavioural gates sit behind it
findings.distinctFrom138: #138 asks the host to enforce a parent tool boundary; this asks the host to let anyone observe a child session's tool roster

findings.observed: one read-only bash call, the session's first action, issued in parallel with a glob for the same purpose: a recursive Get-ChildItem search of the profile root for *cycle*setup* and *PROCEDURE*
findings.consequence: this run is not a shell-free setup and is not put forward as one; nothing was mutated by it
findings.note: the prohibition lives inside the document the session used a shell to locate, so the procedure could not bind the action that found the procedure
findings.remedy: SKILL.md, which the host loads, should name the procedure's path and forbid discovering it through a shell
findings.coordinatorAccountWasWrong: the close-out described a clean native-only run; the session records show otherwise

findings.requirement: validate_receipt is callable through the host's MCP tool path
findings.observed: every encoding was rejected — booleans reported back as not boolean, array entries arriving wrapped as {"item": [...]}; the receipt itself validates cleanly off-session
findings.consequence: the operation is sound but unreachable from a live session
findings.remedy: accept a JSON string for `receipt` in addition to an object, sidestepping the host's object encoding

releaseVerdictNote: the previous two runs were blocked by defects in this plugin; this one was not. What blocks the release now is that the host cannot show what tools a child session actually had.
